target: Violate HACKDAC_p57: when dma_ctrl_reg==CTRL_ABORT and done_i==0, next cycle dma_ctrl_reg must not be CTRL_ABORT. Find a state where abort issued with no active command and DMA gets stuck.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, DMA idle, done_i is 0
DMA abort command issued with no active transfer (done_i==0)
Violation: DMA remains stuck in CTRL_ABORT state next cycle — abort with no active command leaves DMA in unknown state
